decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the selected LED part, manufacturer, package, dimensions, mounting, and color channels.
A same-message MODIFY already records the selected LED model, LCSC number, manufacturer, and complete package specification.
Selecting a specific LCSC LED part does not change the existing connector sourceability and compatible-alternative policy.
The LED part selection does not affect connector-pin silkscreen labels.
The charge-status indication path remains an SK6812 chain; the source does not identify or change the charge-status output implementation.
LED package and sourcing details do not change the monitored rails or spare monitoring-channel count.
The LED part selection does not affect panel button, switch, connector, or GPIO assignments.
The source specifies an LED package but does not change the power board's dimensions, orientation, mounting holes, or connector placement.
The precise SK6812 model and package do not change the established 5V rail behavior, load assignment, or independent LED power control.
Selecting an LED component does not change the three-board architecture or the roles and exclusions of the main and sensor boards.
The LED model and package selection does not alter any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The selected LED part does not change the power board's four-layer stack.
